sources.title: LLM Prompt Evaluator - GitHub
sources.snippet: A lightweight Python-based tool for simulating human-in-the-loop evaluation of Large Language Model (LLM) outputs. This project enables structured scoring of AI responses using customizable rubrics and exports results to a CSV for further analysis. Ideal for testing prompts, auditing model behavior, or contributing to AI training pipelines.

sources.title: SLID: a slit-lamp image dataset for deep learning-based ... - Frontiers
sources.snippet: Currently, there is a scarcity of open-access datasets that include slit-lamp images with detailed anatomical annotations and lesion identification necessary for developing robust AI models applicable to real-world clinical scenarios.
